messages:
Sam Nguyen: Originating RC for feature/kv-caching-optim. Artifact: redwood/infra:rc-20240317-12b9f (sha: 8f1d2b3). Requesting ops + oncall signoff for canary window 2024-03-17 15:00-15:30 UTC. Plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 20m. Rollback command at the bottom. @Alex Rivera please confirm KV warm and telemetry assertions.

deploy-bot: Build finished for rc-20240317-12b9f. Artifacts: [rc-20240317-12b9f]. Smoke tests: PASS. Smoke logs: ```smoke: all services healthy, 0 errors```

Alex Rivera: Canary config below. Stop conditions: p95 latency > 250ms OR error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m. KV warm command: `./scripts/kv_warm.sh --prefix /rc/8f1d2b`. Routing weights: [1,10,50,100].

oncall-sre: Need explicit telemetry assertions before we start (p95, error_rate, qps). Also what's the rollback threshold?

Sam Nguyen: Telemetry assertions: model_p95 < 200ms, error_rate < 0.4%, embed_qps >= 50. Rollback threshold: error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 increase > 30% over baseline for 5m. Taking baseline snapshot now.

deploy-bot: Telemetry baseline snapshot created: tb-7412. Canary rollout scheduled: 2024-03-17T15:00:00Z. To start canary: `deploy promote --artifact rc-20240317-12b9f --to canary`

Maria Chen: Quick checklist: release notes drafted (link below), security review OK, no DB migrations, config flag created, ops runbook updated. @Elaine (pm) can you confirm release notes copy?

Elaine (pm): Release notes published: https://confluence.internal/release/rc-20240317 (short summary + upgrade notes). Notifying early-access customers. :shipit:

Alex Rivera: Starting KV warm now: `./scripts/kv_warm.sh --prefix /rc/8f1d2b`
Output: ```WARM START /rc/8f1d2b
WARMED 1024 keys in 42s
WARM COMPLETE```

oncall-sre: Good. KV warmed. Waiting for initial canary metric snapshot (first 5m). Keep an eye on model_p95 and error_rate.

deploy-bot: Canary stage 1 (1%) started at 2024-03-17T15:00:00Z. Monitoring metrics...

deploy-bot: Canary metrics snapshot (stage 1) -- baseline vs canary:
- model_p95: baseline 180ms -> canary 190ms
- error_rate: baseline 0.12% -> canary 0.15%
- qps: baseline 120 -> canary 118
All metrics within assertion thresholds.

Maria Chen: +1 from security and product. No obvious regressions in the first snapshot.

Sam Nguyen: Proceeding to stage 2 (10%) at +5m unless objections. Rollback command if needed: `deploy rollback --to-artifact stable-20240228-9a7c`

Alex Rivera: No objections from infra. :thumbsup:

Elaine (pm): Release notes and customer emails queued. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Stage 2 (10%) applied at 2024-03-17T15:05:00Z. Monitoring...

deploy-bot: Stage 3 (50%) applied at 2024-03-17T15:12:00Z. Metrics: model_p95 195ms, error_rate 0.18%, qps 115. Within thresholds.

oncall-sre: Monitoring APM traces — tail latency shows a small bump but within alerting margin. Keeping watch for 30m.

Maria Chen: All checks green. Recommend full promotion to prod at 15:20 UTC if no regressions in the next 5m.

Sam Nguyen: Promoting to prod at 15:20 UTC. Final rollback command repeat: `deploy rollback --to-artifact stable-20240228-9a7c`.

Alex Rivera: :thumbsup: go for promote.

deploy-bot: Promotion started: promote --artifact rc-20240317-12b9f --to prod
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Artifact rc-20240317-12b9f pinned as prod. Post-deploy smoke: PASS. Traffic now at 100%.

oncall-sre: Will monitor metrics for 30m and escalate on threshold breach.

Sam Nguyen: Thanks all — closing origination. If anything odd appears, use rollback command above and notify #eng-oncall. :slightly_smiling_face:
